record.title: Russia national land-border pandemic movement restrictions
record.scope: Single national legal order covering European and Asian borders, recorded once. The country list is a regional catalogue subset, not an exhaustive statement of the order’s scope; no universal operational footprint is approved.
record.crossings: Road, rail, pedestrian and mixed checkpoints; Belarus land segment
record.movement: Nonexempt cross-border passenger movement, including Russian outward travel
record.exceptions: Freight/transport and diplomatic crews; bereavement; specified Kaliningrad rail transit and Donbas residents; other decree categories
record.enforcement: Official operational or policy record; independent observation not established unless specified.
record.consequences: Not independently established in this pass
record.relationship: National order has transregional scope. Asian crossing-specific phases may overlap; not independent national decisions.
record.status_observation: Formal permission or repeal dated by evidence; operational resumption is not independently established for the full stated scope.
record.context: Strengthened earlier foreigner-entry rules; numerous amendments during 2020–22. National policy also affects Asian/Caucasus frontiers, which must not be counted as separate independent orders.
record.uncertainty: 15 July repeal ends pandemic legal regime, not war-related closures or restrictions imposed by neighbours. Initial foreigner ban 18 March and bilateral easing phases are not separately reconstructed.

historical.duration_note: Formal change of permission; operational reopening and continuous effective duration not established
